 "content": "def transform(grid):
    """Reflect a square grid across its central horizontal and vertical axes,
    producing a 3-by-3 mirror tiling."""
    n = len(grid)
    if n == 0 or any(len(row) != n for row in grid):
        raise ValueError("expected a non-empty square grid")
    source = list(range(n - 1, -1, -1)) + list(range(n)) + list(range(n - 1, -1, -1))
    return [[grid[source[r]][source[c]] for c in range(3 * n)] for r in range(3 * n)]

if __name__ == "__main__":
    demo_in = [[7, 6, 7], [2, 7, 6], [1, 2, 7]]
    demo_out = [
        [7,2,1,1,2,7,7,2,1], [6,7,2,2,7,6,6,7,2], [7,6,7,7,6,7,7,6,7],
        [7,6,7,7,6,7,7,6,7], [6,7,2,2,7,6,6,7,2], [7,2,1,1,2,7,7,2,1],
        [7,2,1,1,2,7,7,2,1], [6,7,2,2,7,6,6,7,2], [7,6,7,7,6,7,7,6,7],
    ]
    assert transform(demo_in) == demo_out
    print(transform([[8, 8, 6], [6, 3, 6], [6, 8, 8]]))
    print("demo verified")
",
